### We Become What We Worship
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-10-2024.html
Passage: Galatians 4:8-9
Points:
- People often devote themselves to modern idols like wealth, ambition, and physical desires.
- An idol is essentially human desire magnified and worshipped in place of God.
- Whatever captures a person's devotion will eventually mold and define who they become.
- Worshipping false gods leads back into spiritual enslavement.
- Fixating on Jesus Christ transforms believers into His image rather than the likeness of worldly idols.

### The Slavery of the Flesh
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/slavery-flesh
Passage: Galatians 4:8–11
Points:
- Forgetting the darkness from which God rescued us puts believers at risk of falling back into spiritual bondage.
- Salvation is entirely God's merciful initiative, moving believers from ignorance to being known by Him.
- Attempting to complete or secure salvation through religious calendars and legalistic rituals returns people to elementary worldly principles.
- Seeking righteousness through the law continually afflicts the conscience because human works can never satisfy God's standard.
- True Christian liberty is found solely in acknowledging our inability and resting in God's grace.
